sentences.text: Hmph. The temperature in the ironing room was observed at 22.4 °C between 02:00 and 06:00.
This reading significantly exceeded the expected range of 20.8 °C to 21.6 °C.
The peak of this warmth with no source occurred at 03:00.
Maybe this spike was caused by a nearby appliance or a change in airflow, rather than anything spectral.
